highlights:
Egypt: The Mohamed Salah-led Egypt will try to get a point off Belgium in the opener, but the real goal is to get 4-6 points off Iran and New Zealand and finish second.

There’s a pretty clear path to second place for Egypt. Salah is the guy, but Omar Marmoush is going to have a few chances to really shine. I’ll veer in Marmoush’s direction to be Egypt’s top scorer. He’s a personal favorite of mine. I loved watching him at Eintracht Frankfurt before his big-money move to Manchester City.

Norway: Haaland is going to get all of the Norway headlines, but may I offer a contrarian pick here. Alexander Sorloth at +650 to be Norway’s top scorer. Sorloth has 26 international goals of his own. He’ll benefit if a lot of the defensive attention goes to Haaland. As for the team as a whole, I think Norway can get 3-4 group-stage points.
